# netbox_secret_backend (Resource)

Mounts the NetBox secrets engine and writes its connection config, including the seeded admin token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "netbox_admin_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "netbox_secret_backend" "netbox" {
  path       = "netbox"
  netbox_url = "https://netbox.example.com"
  token      = var.netbox_admin_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `netbox_url` (String) Base URL of the NetBox server (e.g. https://netbox.example.com).
- `path` (String) Mount path for the NetBox secrets engine (e.g. "netbox").

### Optional

- `ca_cert` (String) PEM CA certificate that signed the NetBox server's TLS certificate.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the mount.
- `plugin` (String) Name of the plugin in the plugin catalog. Defaults to "vault-plugin-secrets-netbox".
- `request_timeout_seconds` (Number) HTTP timeout in seconds for calls from the plugin to NetBox.
- `tls_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS verification of the NetBox server (not recommended).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Seeded NetBox admin API token. Write-only on the backend; not read back. Omit to manage it out-of-band (e.g. via config/rotate).
- `token_version` (Number) NetBox token version to request when minting (2 by default; use 1 if NetBox has no API_TOKEN_PEPPERS).

### Read-Only

- `admin_token_id` (Number) NetBox token id of the seeded admin token (computed; maintained by the engine across rotations).
- `admin_user_id` (Number) NetBox user id of the seeded admin token (computed; the engine auto-discovers/maintains it for rotation).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by mount path.
terraform import netbox_secret_backend.netbox netbox
```
